description: Utility functions for handling key metadata, filtering sensitive fields, extracting logging settings, formatting for display, and managing tags within metadata objects.

methods.name: filterSensitiveMetadata
methods.description: Filters out sensitive information from metadata for display purposes.

methods.name: extractLoggingSettings
methods.description: Safely extracts logging settings from metadata.

methods.name: formatMetadataForDisplay
methods.description: Formats metadata for JSON display, excluding sensitive fields.

methods.name: stripTagsFromMetadata
methods.description: Removes the 'tags' property from metadata objects to prevent duplication.
